_README: Scripts that are KNOWN to fail on main right now. runVerifySuite treats a
listed script's failure as EXPECTED and does not fail the run — which is what
makes a zero-red CI gate landable on a tree that has four deliberately-not-yet-
(same mechanism, same contract) when CI was added here 2026-08-31 — see that
repo's copy for the sibling convention this mirrors.
THIS LIST IS NOT A MUTE BUTTON. A listed script that PASSES fails the suite,
loudly, as a STALE entry. That is the property that stops an allowlist rotting
into a rug: you cannot fix a bug and leave its harness suppressed, and you
cannot park a flaky script here and forget it. Removing the entry is part of
the fix, in the same commit.
Every entry needs a reason someone can act on. 'flaky' is not a reason.

verifyCostAttribution.js.reason: 70/72 checks pass. Two 2026-08-24 cost-attribution follow-up gaps are still open (7k/7l): generateForAd's refreshStaleLayoutInput call and its buildReferenceImages call do not yet thread real campaignRunId / ad-derived attribution onto the spend they cause.
verifyCostAttribution.js.removeWhen: 7k and 7l are wired to pass real campaignRunId / ad-derived attribution the same way the other five stages already do — delete this entry in the same commit.

verifyDirectorFallbackChain.js.reason: 46/47 checks pass.
